# American RadioWorks

> > Award-winning documentary journalism from American Public Media exploring social issues through in-depth investigative reporting and personal stories.

American RadioWorks is the documentary unit of American Public Media, producing long-form radio documentaries and multimedia features on education, criminal justice, immigration, housing policy, and economic inequality. Led by journalists including Stephen Smith, Emily Hanford, Sasha Aslanian, and Chris Farrell, the series combines investigative reporting with human narratives from communities across America.

## Key Topics

- Documentary journalism
- Education policy and reform
- Teacher evaluation
- Early childhood education
- Immigration and visa processes
- Personal bankruptcy and debt
- Public housing desegregation
- Criminal justice
- Economic inequality
- Latino college access
- Military and veterans issues
- Infrastructure policy
- American Public Media
- Investigative reporting

## Education and Learning

- [Early Lessons - Perry Preschool Study Results](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/preschool/results.html): Perry Preschool study results: early childhood education impact
- [Testing Teachers - What is Good Teaching?](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/testing_teachers/insight2.html): Tim Daly on teacher evaluation & student learning outcomes
- [Rising by Degrees - Latino College Access](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/latino_college/a1.html): Latino college access: Katy Sorto's first-gen student journey
- [Inventing a New Kind of College](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/tomorrows-college/lectures/inventing-new-college.html): U of Minnesota Rochester: innovative teaching methods & active learning
- [Testing Teachers - Resources](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/testing_teachers/links.html): Teacher evaluation research resources & education policy links
- [Early Lessons - Resource Links](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/preschool/links.html): Perry Preschool & early childhood education resource links

## Economic Justice and Financial Hardship

- [Bankruptcy: Maxed Out in America](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/bankruptcy/index.html): Main page: consumer bankruptcy & debt crisis documentary series
- [Bankruptcy - Personal Stories](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/bankruptcy/b2.html): Personal bankruptcy stories: medical bills, debt & financial hardship
- [Bankruptcy - Financial Education Programs](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/bankruptcy/c4.html): Annika Graham's story: single mothers & financial education programs

## Housing and Community Development

- [After the Projects - Gautreaux Program](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/housing/a3.html): Gautreaux program: Chicago public housing desegregation & mobility
- [After the Projects - Full Transcript](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/housing/transcript.html): Full transcript: Chicago public housing demolition documentary
- [Bridge to Somewhere - WPA Music](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/infrastructure/music.html): Music list: WPA Federal Music Project recordings & soundtrack

## Immigration and Identity

- [Pueblo, USA - Marriage Visa Journey](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/immigration/es1.html): Immigration story: Sue Marks & Juan Videa's marriage visa journey
- [Pueblo, USA - Spanish Edition](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/immigration/indexs.html): Spanish-language immigration documentary series main page

## Criminal Justice and Military

- [What Killed Sergeant Gray](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/vets/e1.html): Iraq War investigation: Sgt. Adam Gray's death & detainee abuse
- [Gangster Confidential](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/gangster/b1.html): Rene Enriquez interview: Mexican Mafia defector testimony

## Multimedia Resources

- [University of Minnesota Rochester Photos](https://americanradioworks.publicradio.org/features/tomorrows-college/lectures/slideshow.html): UMR campus photo gallery: innovative learning spaces & classrooms
